texts: A1–A3 per m² relative to the pooled typology factor (2025)
note: L6 best-practice ratio: Harrell–Davis quantile of 14 independent case studies (detached, townhouses); Harrell & Davis (1982) Biometrika 69, 635; percentile bootstrap (Efron & Tibshirani 1993). The Ambitious q = 0.15 follows the top-15% convention of Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2021/2139, Annex I s. 7.7. Apartments (one independent case) are not in the sample.
